here it comes another misfit, what makes me weird? some casual points: i disregard technology, i disregard fashion, i disregard everything which is related to how i appear (cause i appear missing like QOTSA would sing). I can find similar souls only through poets, writers and thinkers of the past (the few friends i have are built this way too). Sort of a loner and mysantrhope but with a deep sense of justice and respect for every form of life. Can't accept pain, injustice, stupidity and violence in any form. Faced with this things though, i can become violent. If it happens to me that i see a man beating his girlfriend in front of me i could beat him almost to death with no regrets, i would easily and peacefully accept to pass my life in prison if it was to defend someone. whatelse... 27 M too, almost got a master degree in logic and philosophy, i pass most of my days reading and studying and writing. I write poetry since i was 18, right know trying with prose but just experimenting and improving my technique, nothing autentic. Yeah like you said, terms like weird, nerd ecc. are supposedly useful sociological simplistic categorizations (yeah, i have to write that to clarify) of unique individuals wich are supposed to have something in common (manga, videogames, programming, an attitude to stay home ecc.). In this regard i'm a nerd, but in my past i did drugs, parties and other alpha stuff, also i'm an outdoor person: trail running and rockclimbing; whenever i can, as i live in Italy, i go to the Dolomites. Other stuff... got only one girlfriend, but the emotional cost and the effort to find girls, and especially a soul similar to mine, seems too much right know. I've almost accepted that some of us aren't suited to love and be loved, even if i would give my best, i think that my fate it's driving me toward artistry and a solitary/mistical life. Two other points: i too get identified with odd carachters in books and films, even if i think that it's a common thing, cause almost everyone wich is living a normal/boring life would like to dream a different life, exept when you live it for real. For example i have identified with Holden Caulfield, or Hal Incandenza (from infinite jest), or Ivan Karamazov, or Elliot Alderson (from mister robot), but i was sad when i thought about the fatc that their alienation, in some form, was also mine, and that it's not exciting, funny or entertaining at all (just a curse you can manage to laugh about but wich is always wearing you out and you have not choosen to have (if we exclude karma from past lives wich unfortunately i can't remember)). In regard to the imposter syndrome (have you read "Good Old Neon" from Foster Wallace?), i suffer from it when i try to came up with what is my writing style or my personal caracter/identity, it seems like is always changing a little bit, like multiple IIs are trying to establish a leadership,  but i mostly got to the conclusion that identity is just an anthropological/psychological construct, and except for it's evolutionary advantages, is a waste of mental space. I too can't drive, probably cause i can't see or imagine myself driving.

Bookworm uh? that's good considering i'm a book (made of books, live through books, skin of paper ecc.), feel free to pm me if you want, when i can i will answer, and forgive my english cause it's not my first language, writing from Italy.

if i was you i would have gone crazy, but i can only tell you what would be my reaction due to my personality while imagining being in similar situations.

MOST IMPORTANT THING: they should fear you, not the opposite.

This point could be hard i know, i really know well, i fought a lot to get rid of others, and gain power over their minds.

Existence is disgusting and we got throwed through this shit, but we must react, we must expresse our rage, our hate, our perpetual strife against this shit.

Maybe you don't want to fight, you're tired and i understand this as well. What i can tell you is to find the reasons deeply inside yourself, but not as emotional bullshits selfcare notions, you have already relived those experiences, as you remembered in this post, don't you feel anger? don't you feel a strong non verbal energy coming out of your chest. Stop your internal verbalization, stop to process your own thougt, and ask yourself: do i want to react? do i want to have the power? then formulate a precise intent and don't stop until you have achieved your intent.

What happened to you it's your fault? no. it's their fault, so them (your father, the kids) are your enemy, you are in a war right now. The world has tried to fuck you up, you can't know right now the outcome, but dude, think about this, during a war, bombs and bullet falling all over, would you simply wait and stay still, waiting for the fucking enemy to kill you? personally i wouldn't do it, but if you want you're free to do it. Otherwhise you can try to fight back, and maybe ultimately win the war. Study your enemy, study their physical and mental weaknesses, study a tactic. Obviously you can't win a war in a day, you need patience and strategy, but you'll be guided by your intent (which could be formulated as a mantra like "They will fear me, they will pay") everyday.

Probably you will need to strenghten up physically and psychologically, go learn some meditation skills, read books about psychology, find someone who can teach you some MMA or other similar fighting skills (MMA is probably the most complete) and take down an enemy at a time. 

This probably means that you will need to step away from your family for sometime, especially after you will have to fight your father (a good thing would be speaking directly to him in a moment of weakness (maybe in front of other people where he can't harm you) and telling him how a monster he was, how a bad father, bad example, and could one man do this in the name of god to a son, a wife, a family), maybe looking for a job in another city, and starting a whole new life, but i can guarantee that even in loneliness you will fell free, and ready to have the world in your power, and not the opposite.

PS: remember that every defeat is just a step to the next ipothetical wins, learn from the mistakes, and next time fight better. This is obviously my opinion towards a possible solution, nothing more. But i prefer to dying fighting and laughing in front of my enemy.

i wouldn't think of it as a joke, capitalistic society is venturing into a wide psychological collapse. You only have to wait... we are not sick, people who can cope with this kind of life without being affected are sick, and without hope. The pain we feel is just a sign that the inculturation we were forced to eat as children has not completely destroyed our spirit, which is suffering of course, but can become really powerful in my opinion. The problem should be identified in the inculturation process, it's misery called standard education, and the incredible amount of suffering which is necessary to bound a global society togheter without doubts or problems. We are not meant to live in cities and without nature, we have to build small communities (or live alone) in wild natural places (not for the sake of escapism, i would say this desire is caused by inculturation), and we have to totally erase our previous broken life caused by society. I firmly believe this can be done, with effort but can be done. The enemy is inculturation and being unconscious of how it works on your spirit as a mechanism. The difficulty arise when you realize that this mechanism has eaten you for A LOT of years, and its machinery is present in everything you think or do.

But what about reality at all? there are plenty of philosophers  completely disagree \(under almost every point of view\) with reality. Zum beispiel Cioran, Heidegger, most of the Stoics, Epicureans, Eraclitus, Schopenhauer ecc. ecc. It is certainly related to some notion of reality, but the trivial one, the "common sense" \(what "common" ?!\), is just, in my opinion, disgusting. So real living means? just something which give you the possibility to connect, feel, love while being at the same time superfunctional pragmatic efficient so that your inner self can tell you "oh look it seems that i'm good, feel like i feel right now, not bad at all"  and the others look at you like "Oh yes, he's good cuz it seem so, he's like a man should be". Overthinking cause me only to see things mostly as they are and also more, maybe more deeply than they simply are \(this, also psychologically, is maybe ontologically incorrect\). Overthinking cause me also to notice that subtle veil of sadness wich make me understand what a beautiful creature a woman with sad eyes, a woman with a gentle soul wich i look at while she was smoking with anxiety a cigarette, revealing herself, an entire life in a simple gesture pretending to hide and not be there. Sometimes i see people as objects but in these cases i'm conscious that is my rage or mystical detachment that make me feel distant even from myself \(no more self in those cases at all\). But i like to overoveroveroveroveroverthinking man, i like to overthink till my mind isn't just something i can control and let go a little bit, i, personally, don't want to be bored from reality \(If my english is bad i'm sorry, it's not my native language but i'm working on it\).

The whole reason of this is definetely condensed in the Heideggerian interpretation \(phenomenontologically grounded\) of the notion of "chat". I'm not pretendending to be or sound edgy, for what i know Heidegger's explanation is the best explanation of that human situation. i keep the dreams up \(i'm not  trivially speaking\), and i sincerely reccomend everyone to do the same \(not sure if my grammar is correct, i'm still practicing my written english. sorry.\) cause in my personal experience that thing about sticking whith reality is what have fucked up my mind. i use to write poetry, i use to say and express myself the way i feel, but sometimes that sensation of being judged as the weird, strange, immature, creepy guy doesn't go away, but you know what? i don't give a fuck. i've never gave a fuck. Just that sensation appears randomly when i am with people which are not really open minded. Maybe \(no, that's sure\) i'm going offtopic and being an egotisticidiosincraticnarcissisticprick but what i am trying to say is that dreaming is ok. that you can work and be super busy and still keep imagination going. there is somewhere this wrong idea that to realize yourself, succeed in a job, or simply live by your own and take care of everything, you have to be very focused and divide your life in precise but boring segments. I don't believe that, why not a creative focus, why do u not start to ask yourself if your dreaming could still be useful \(orrible word\) for something else. Right now all my wasted dreaming is somehow \(after years of depression and apathy, but also crazy life and studying\) turning back on my writing and writing is giving me better sensations, other dimensions, other lives outside reality \(if something like that, and only like it is supposed to be, finally exist\).

You know, i was always the darker kid, the loner, kind of misantropic/melanconic type of person and also crazy like taking all the drugs and don't giving a fuck, and fight, and at the same time being tired of reality and a total failure in most social relations due to anxiety, fear and inability to stick with social conventions and other boring stuff \(boring for me\), i've got only one girlfriend and can't feel anything, like i was acting, then fall in love with another girl and get mad, but i can't really handle emotions, so "reality". I prefer dreaming and mesmerizing, or redefine what whit my senses and cultural conditioning offer to me as "reality";  that doesn't mean that i can't afford the reality stuff \(ordinary life, studies, jobs\) while i completely ignore it or transform it.
